issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

enabled.description: Whether translation for multi-lingual support is enabled for the app.

translatorTypeName.description: The language translation type name to route the requests to.

llmConfigName.description:
The name of the Llm config to use for translation.
This will be used only when translatorTypeName is 'Genai.Translator.Llm'.

documentTranslatorTypeName.description:
Specifies the translator type name used for routing document translation requests.

- **File-level translation**: Translates entire documents before chunking.
- **Passage-level translation**: Translates passages after chunking.
- If no `documentTranslatorTypeName` is specified, it defaults to `{#translatorTypeName}`:
  - Uses passage-level translation for LLM-based services.
  - Uses file-level translation for other translation services.

languageDetectionHandlerTypeName.description: Translator Type name to route language detection requests to. If no name is specified, falls back to #translatorTypeName.

queryTranslatorTypeName.description: Translator Type name to route query translation requests to. If no name is specified, falls back to #translatorTypeName.

supportedFileTypes.description: List of supported file types for translation during the chunking process.

unsupportedLanguageCodes.description: All unsupported ISO-639 language codes for the translation services, e.g. `gu` for Gujarati.

languageConfidenceThreshold.description:
The language confidence threshold for the translation service.
If the confidence of the detected language is below this threshold, the translation service will not translate the text.

apiKey.description: The authentication key for the Azure API.
